'''Yensi Kolyin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] that lived at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was working with the pirate [[Dalla Solo]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], but when Kolyin wanted to get out of the business, Solo sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to kill Kolyin.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SmugglerTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depiction of Yensi Kolyin, none of which include the male Gran depiction deemed canon in ''Legends'']]
Yensi Kolyin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> He appeared during a [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] given out by [[Dalla Solo]], in which the player had to travel to a specified location and [[Death/Legends|kill]] Kolyin.<ref name="AED" />

Because Yensi Kolyin spawned under the generic "smuggler" template, his appearance was randomized under one of eight possible depictions. He could either appear as four different types of [[Human/Legends|Human]] males, or as four different types of Human females. Because the quest dialogue identified Kolyin as a male Gran, this article assumes that the eight possible Human depictions are [[Canon|non-canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
